text: The Cartan integers $\langle \beta, \alpha^\vee \rangle = 2(\beta,\alpha)/(\alpha,\alpha)$ of a root system take values only in:
explanation: The closure axiom forces $\langle\beta,\alpha^\vee\rangle \in \mathbb{Z}$, but the angle and length constraints of a root system pin it to $\{0,\pm1,\pm2,\pm3\}$ (the value $\pm3$ occurs only in $G_2$). Orthogonal roots give $0$, so 'never $0$' is wrong, and the value is not an arbitrary integer.
